general.title: OMIX Limma Analysis
general.instructions:
Choose Single Matrix for the established continuous-matrix Limma analysis, or Cell-Type Collection for selected/all OMIX Seurat Pseudobulk collection output.

For Single Matrix, select files explicitly or attach one upstream result bundle and leave the file selectors blank for unambiguous discovery. Select Input Data Type so the scientific interpretation and automatic variance model are reproducible. Raw-count pseudobulk is rejected and must be analyzed with OMIX DEG Analysis.

For Cell-Type Collection, attach the complete selected/all Pseudobulk collection and select Pseudobulk_Collection_Manifest.dcf (or leave it blank only when exactly one is attached). The capsule runs independent donor-level M-F Limma models for every ordered cell type. It does not read Seurat objects, pool cells, or fit a cell-type interaction model. Its L2P_Multi_Input.csv handoff uses ordered stable-ID-qualified comparisons named <stable-cell-type-id>__M-F; select that file as the OMIX L2P Multi deg_table.

For Single Matrix, contrasts may be left blank only when the selected model contains exactly two groups with at least two samples each. In that one unambiguous case, the comparison is inferred and recorded; otherwise provide the intended contrast explicitly.

categories.name: Inputs
categories.description: Choose one analysis route. Single Matrix uses a continuous matrix, matching metadata, and optional ordinary Pseudobulk manifest. Cell-Type Collection uses the top-level selected/all Pseudobulk collection manifest.

categories.name: Model
categories.description: Define groups, contrasts, optional covariates, and repeated-measure blocking.

categories.name: Data Interpretation
categories.description: Declare input scale, variance model, and duplicate-feature summarization.

categories.name: Advanced
categories.description: Restrict samples or control whether modeled values are appended to the result table.

parameters.name: Analysis Route
parameters.description: single_matrix preserves the established continuous-matrix Limma workflow. cell_type_collection consumes selected/all OMIX Seurat Pseudobulk collection output and writes L2P Multi input.

parameters.name: Continuous Matrix File
parameters.description: Feature-by-sample CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS. Leave blank to discover exactly one compatible continuous matrix under /data.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata File
parameters.description: Aligned sample metadata CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS. Leave blank to discover exactly one compatible metadata table under /data.

parameters.name: Pseudobulk Manifest
parameters.description: Optional Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf. Leave blank to use one unambiguous attached manifest or to run a general continuous matrix without one.

parameters.name: Pseudobulk Collection Manifest
parameters.description: Required for Cell-Type Collection: top-level Pseudobulk_Collection_Manifest.dcf from OMIX Seurat Pseudobulk selected/all mode. Leave blank only when exactly one compatible collection manifest is attached. Do not use Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf here.

parameters.name: Feature ID Column
parameters.description: Feature identifier column in the matrix.

parameters.name: Sample ID Column
parameters.description: Unique sample identifier column in sample metadata.

parameters.name: Contrast Variable Columns
parameters.description: One or two comma-separated metadata columns defining modeled groups.

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated limma contrast expressions, such as B-A or 1-0. Leave blank only when the selected model has exactly two groups with at least two samples each; the sole comparison will be inferred and recorded.

parameters.name: Collection Contrast
parameters.description: Cell-Type Collection only. Fixed donor-level comparison; the current canonical collection contract supports M-F.

parameters.name: Covariate Columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated fixed-effect metadata columns.

parameters.name: Batch Effect Columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated technical batch columns. They are included in the Limma model and may be removed only from the optional downstream expression matrix.

parameters.name: Donor Variable Column
parameters.description: Optional repeated-measure donor or patient column. Use only when a donor contributes multiple modeled profiles.

parameters.name: Input Data Type
parameters.description: Scientific interpretation of the matrix. Auto uses a compatible pseudobulk manifest or the backward-compatible Input Kind mapping. Select the explicit type for other matrices so the variance model and effect labels are reproducible.

parameters.name: Input Kind
parameters.description: Controls effect-size labeling. Auto derives log2 expression, enrichment score, or generic continuous score from Input Data Type.

parameters.name: Measurement Scale
parameters.description: Short description of the supplied measurement scale. Required for other_continuous and recommended for externally prepared matrices.

parameters.name: Fraction Transform
parameters.description: Transformation for CIBERSORT relative fractions. Auto uses arcsin square root; logit uses the boundary pseudocount.

parameters.name: Fraction Pseudocount
parameters.description: Boundary replacement used only for an explicit logit transform of CIBERSORT relative fractions. Must be greater than 0 and less than 0.5.

parameters.name: Variance Model
parameters.description: auto uses a compatible Pseudobulk manifest recommendation, otherwise template-equivalent eBayes. Select ebayes_trend only for a justified mean-dependent variance trend.

parameters.name: Duplicate Feature Summarization
parameters.description: How duplicate feature IDs are combined before modeling.

parameters.name: Samples to Include
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated sample IDs. Leave blank to use all metadata samples found in the matrix, in metadata order.

parameters.name: Append Modeled Matrix
parameters.description: Append the aligned modeled sample values to Limma_Analysis.csv.

parameters.name: Write Batch-Corrected Expression
parameters.description: When Batch Effect Columns are supplied, write Batch_Corrected_Expression.csv for downstream continuous-expression tools. This does not change Limma DE statistics.
